field

components · 0.6.0 · E3 · aj-c-field

A text field. Single line by default; a textarea in the auth forms and the entry editor, a select in the auth forms. Never autofocused. In the no-script comps a div stands in for it, its hint shown as a placeholder.

statedefaultyes: as rendered
statehovern/a: no hover treatment
statefocus-visibleyes: the box's own border, 2px in --block, drawn inward (--w-focus: a 1px outline just inside the 1px border); nothing outside the box is covered; a refused value keeps its 2px --action-delete
stateactiven/a: a field is not pressed
statedisabledn/a: fields are never disabled; an unavailable action is not shown
stateselectedn/a: not a choice
stateloadingn/a: a field is never waiting
stateerroryes: aria-invalid="true" in the auth forms takes the alert border, --w-alert in --action-delete; the message is written under the field (the auth help line)
stateemptyyes: the placeholder hint

Input

A single-line field, as in the auth forms.

Composer

The composer's field, empty (01-today).

Textarea

The live composer’s field (the prototypes and the website): one line centred in the box, growing evenly.

Account textarea

A textarea in an account form (16-flow-states): a block with the form's padding.

Editor textarea

The entry editor's textarea (18-entry-system-states): three --ctl tall, --s6 padding.

Select

The native timezone picker in the auth forms.

Div

The no-script comps stand in a div for the field.
